clips.title: The story
paras: In the northern Barrens, Thun'grim Firegaze's steel bars are missing. Recovering them will prove a warrior's resolve to reclaim stolen property.

Thun'grim Firegaze, a visually impaired orc smith, keeps a camp in the northern Barrens. Razormane quilboar took his iron chest during a night raid, distracting him with grunts and snorts while thieves slipped away. Unable to work fine steel, the quilboar left the unopened chest near a ruined wagon in their encampment to the northwest. The bars remain intact for warriors willing to recover them.
